solutions.title: Minute-by-minute simulation
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly scan the grid for fresh oranges adjacent to a currently rotten orange and mark the next wave.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each minute can scan the whole grid, and there can be O(mn) minutes.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The next-wave list can hold many cells.

solutions.title: Multi-source BFS
solutions.strategy: Start BFS from every initially rotten orange so each fresh orange is processed at the earliest minute it rots.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every grid cell is enqueued at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue can contain a full layer of grid cells.
